QuestInfo.name: Wrapping up the Panda Teddy
QuestInfo.0: Robert Holly the toy factory employee is busy. Ask if he needs help.
QuestInfo.1: Robert Holly said that too many orders for toys came in and there aren't enough workers to fill them. He needs help wrapping up Panda Teddies. Wrap them by clicking on #r#t2270031##k.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Robert Holly by wrapping up the Panda Teddy in a box and having it ready for release.

0.0: Busy, busy, busy! Hmm? I don't think I've seen you before. I'm Robert Holly, manager of toy factory production. I guess I'm kind of like the vice president of the company.
0.1: So, why am I so overwhelmed? The toy orders keep coming in, but there's not enough personnel to take care of the packaging... I'd even hire animals at this point. Can you help us out?

yes.0: Use this #r#t2270031##k to wrap up the #rPanda Teddies#k.

no.0: Well if you're too busy, then oh well. But are you REALLY too busy?

1.0: I wish those Teddy monsters would just go quietly into the stupid box!

default.0: You have to weaken the #rPanda Teddy#k before you can put it in the #r#t2270031##k! They put up a fight!
